applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No bilateral investment treaty is in force in Bermuda's own name; UK bilateral investment treaties are not automatically extended to Bermuda.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Bermuda AML/CFT and UBO obligations are governed primarily by the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Act 2018, the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Regulations 2018, the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 (as amended), the Anti-Terrorism (Financial and Other Measures) Act 2004, the Financial Intelligence Agency Act 2007, the Companies Act 1981 (as amended), the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018, the Economic Substance Act 2018, and the BMA AML/ATF Guidance Notes and Sector Specific Guidance.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority in the country of origin, notarized by a notary public or other recognized certifying official

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Consular Legalization where required; certified English translation where the document is not in English

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, officers, shareholders, and beneficial owners before appointment or admission against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Bermuda domestic sanctions notices. PEP status, whether foreign or domestic, triggers enhanced due diligence requiring senior-management approval, independent verification of source of wealth and source of funds, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Screening must be repeated periodically and upon any trigger event; records must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship. Failure to conduct mandatory screening is an offence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Act 2018 and related BMA rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies — Companies Registry e-Services portal administered by the Government of Bermuda (gov.bm)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory applications and company documents must be filed in English. A proposed corporate name must be representable in the Roman/Latin alphabet; non-Latin script names are not registered. If a foreign-language name or transliteration is proposed, a certified English translation and transliteration explanation must accompany the name-clearance application. Corporate endings must follow statutory form, typically 'Limited' or 'Ltd', and the name must be distinguishable from existing registered names, not misleading, and not contrary to public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An approved name is reserved for 90 days. If incorporation has not been completed before expiry, the applicant may apply to the Registrar before expiry for a further reservation period of up to 90 days, paying the prescribed extension fee and reconfirming the original name-clearance facts. If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the applicant must obtain written grounds of refusal and may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of Companies within 21 days of the refusal notice. If reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file an originating appeal or application for judicial review in the Supreme Court of Bermuda under the Companies Act 1981. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately file a modified name for clearance without prejudice to the right to pursue the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-only office is not acceptable for the statutory registered office. The Bermuda exempted company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at the office of a licensed corporate services provider, registered law firm, or registered agent, and must appoint a resident company representative/secretary as required under the Companies Act 1981. A virtual or mail-forwarding address may be used only for non-statutory operational correspondence and does not satisfy the registered-office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: The annualized baseline risk of unannounced physical inspection is estimated at 5% in the absence of adverse flags. The risk rises to approximately 25-35% upon a trigger event such as an economic-substance filing inconsistency, incomplete UBO records, adverse AML screening results, or a regulatory complaint. The Registrar and the Bermuda Monetary Authority are empowered to carry out on-site inspections and to require production of corporate, accounting, and AML records.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Bermuda Companies Act 1981, Part V, Sections 129 to 140 (registration and regulation of exempted companies), as amended
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Application for Registration as an Exempted Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; Bermuda law does not impose capital escrow or paid-in capital requirements for exempted companies. Shares may be issued at no par or with nominal par value in any currency.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the company adopt the Memorandum of Association and the Articles of Incorporation presented to this meeting, and that the officers of the company file the application for registration as a Bermuda exempted company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that each of the subscribers set forth in the Memorandum do hereby subscribe for one ordinary share, par value $1.00, and that the directors allot and issue such shares upon payment of the subscription amount. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the company be established at the office of the licensed registered service provider in Hamilton, Bermuda. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the subscriber and shareholder named in the register be appointed as a director, that the director be elected President, and that the Secretary be appointed as corporate secretary. The Board authorizes the officers and agents to execute banking engagements, engage counsel, and take all necessary steps to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government Administration Building, Hamilton, Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name reservation request to the Registrar of Companies for the proposed exempted company name. The Registrar will confirm that the name is not misleading, offensive, or confusingly similar to an existing registered name. Submission can be made through the corporate service provider using the local registry filing protocol.
required_dossiers: Statement of intended business objects (ISIC 5820 digital publishing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, resubmit with an alternative name or request a written registrars opinion stating the grounds for rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Formation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Bermuda registered office provider or notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum of Association before a notary public; if executed outside Bermuda, the notary signature must be apostilled or legalized. Obtain the written consent of the registered office provider and the first director to confirm their appointments.
required_dossiers: Subscriber identity due diligence (passport and proof of address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Re-execute the defective signature page, cure the notarization defect, or obtain a fresh apostille for the corrected page.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies (via corporate service provider or registry e-filing system)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the application, notarized Memorandum of Association, declarations, and prescribed fee to the Registrar. Verify that all dossiers comply with the Companies Act 1981 and the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017 if applicable. Retain a time-stamped filing receipt.
required_dossiers: Application Form for registration as an exempted company
State filing fee payment receipt (BDA 1,795 equivalent in USD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the registrars query by submitting a supplementary statutory declaration, amending the memorandum, or providing missing exhibits; pay any re-filing or late fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation and register the exempted company in the Bermuda Register of Companies. The certificate will confirm the company number and date of incorporation, at which point legal personality attaches.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error, apply for a certificate of correction under section 7 of the Companies Act, or request a duplicate certificate with payment of the prescribed fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Organizational Governance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to adopt the organizational minutes, approve share issuance and allotment, appoint officers, open bank accounts, and register the beneficial ownership information with the Registrar within the statutory period. Maintain the registered office, share register, and minute book at the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Consent to act of each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial ownership declaration is rejected, file corrected schedules through the corporate service provider and pay any late penalty before the enforcement date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no physical industrial establishment in Bermuda; digital software publishing falls outside the scope of industrial licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or operating licence required for ISIC 5820 software publishing; the certificate of incorporation is the sole mandatory authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA required because the company has no physical premises, plant, or pollutant emission sources.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A - no wastewater, VOC, or waste-handling discharges. If an office lease is later entered, standard municipal waste disposal and sewerage compliance apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: None required for remote software publishing with no Bermudian premises. Should the company later lease an office, a certificate of occupancy from the Building Safety Authority and a fire safety inspection by the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service will be required before occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda: Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (portal: www.gov.bm) and Registrar of Companies (portal: www.gov.bm/companies) for Exempted Company registration and annual government fees. United Kingdom: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC; portal: www.gov.uk/hmrc) for any UK Corporation Tax, VAT, or digital-services tax nexus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the Bermuda Exempted Company under the Companies Act 1981 by filing Memorandum/Articles of Association and applicable forms with the Registrar of Companies; 2) Obtain the Bermuda Company Registration Number and Certificate of Exempted Status; 3) No Bermuda corporate income-tax TIN or VAT ID is generally issued because Bermuda has no corporate income tax and no VAT/GST; the Company Registration Number is the functional tax identifier, and a certificate of tax exemption/status may be obtained from the Office of the Tax Commissioner when foreign counterparties require proof of exemption; a Bermuda employer payroll-tax account is required only if the company employs Bermuda-based staff; 4) If UK nexus arises through UK tax residence or a UK permanent establishment, apply to HMRC for a Corporation Tax Unique Taxpayer Reference using the non-resident company route; 5) For UK digital-service sales where Steam/PlayStation is not the deemed supplier, register the non-UK entity for UK VAT via HMRC’s non-resident digital registration service; if the platform is the deemed supplier, no publisher VAT registration is required for those platform sales.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone. The Bermuda Exempted Company is outside Bermuda’s income tax base and carries no Bermuda corporate income tax; it is also non-UK resident for corporation tax if its central management and control is outside the UK and it has no UK permanent establishment. Bermuda payroll tax and social insurance apply only to local payroll. Digital publishing revenue from Steam and PlayStation remains outside local corporate tax exposure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No Bermuda local election is available because the company is already tax-exempt. For U.S. federal tax purposes, a Bermuda Exempted Company is generally a per se corporation and cannot make a check-the-box election under Form 8832 to be treated as a disregarded entity or partnership. No UK election is required if the company remains non-UK resident; hybrid mismatch rules under TIOPA 2010 Part 10 may require a notice or election only if an actual hybrid mismatch arrangement exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Bermuda: No VAT/GST. United Kingdom: VAT (Value Added Tax) with digital-services place-of-supply rules and online-marketplace deemed-supplier treatment; Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store are electronic interfaces that generally collect and remit VAT for non-established publishers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Bermuda: Not applicable (no VAT/GST registration threshold). UK: £90,000 annual taxable turnover for UK-established businesses; non-UK-established digital suppliers are required to register from the first taxable supply unless a digital marketplace or electronic interface is the deemed VAT supplier.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda: no electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or real-time API requirement. UK: no mandatory B2B e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance; VAT-registered businesses must maintain digital records and file VAT returns through HMRC Making Tax Digital compatible software via HMRC’s MTD API. Platform-generated transaction reports from Steam Partner and PlayStation Partner must be retained as the primary evidence of sales; no separate digital stamping is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Bermuda: not applicable because Bermuda has no VAT/GST and no zero-rating or refund system. UK: for digital downloads, export zero-rating is replaced by outside-scope treatment where the place of supply is outside the UK (B2C digital services taxed at customer location; B2B services generally outside scope). Physical exports from the UK may be zero-rated if the goods are exported within the statutory time limit and proper evidence is held. When Steam/PlayStation is the deemed supplier, the publisher does not charge UK VAT and is not entitled to input VAT recovery on platform commissions; its proceeds are outside the scope of UK VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bermuda: no customs export declaration or customs documentation is required for digital software downloads, Steam/PlayStation licences, or stored-value revenue; Bermuda Customs declarations apply only to physical media movements.

UK physical-media export (if applicable): Customs Export Declaration, commercial invoice, Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, packing list, inward remittance certificate/bank transfer evidence, and proof of removal from the UK within the applicable statutory time limit.

UK digital-services outside-scope substantiation: Steam Partner/Valve payout statements, PlayStation Store payout statements, platform sales analytics, consumer country-of-residence evidence, B2B customer VAT identification numbers, and a record of the platform's deemed-supplier status.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda: no VAT or export zero-rating clawback exists; failure to pay the annual company fee may result in strike-off and penalties. UK: if HMRC determines that a zero-rating or outside-scope position is unsupported, it can assess unpaid VAT, impose default interest, and apply deliberate-inaccuracy penalties up to 100% of the tax; fraudulent evasion of VAT or customs duty is a criminal offence under VATA 1994 and CEMA 1979, carrying unlimited fines and imprisonment. Discovery assessments can reach back up to 20 years, and marketplace or electronic-interface operators can be jointly and severally liable where the deemed-supplier rules are abused.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Bermuda maintains full current and capital account convertibility. The Bermuda Monetary Authority administers exchange control but does not impose approvals for foreign exchange transactions, capital flows, or inward/outward remittances. The Bermudian Dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the United States Dollar (USD), and businesses may freely maintain multi-currency accounts. Profit remittance from a Bermuda Exempted Company is unrestricted, subject only to standard banking due diligence, Economic Substance Act 2018 compliance certification for relevant activities, and CRS/FATCA reporting obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion rules in Bermuda. Exporters and digital publishers may retain 100% of foreign currency receipts in USD, EUR, GBP, or any freely convertible currency without a prescribed timeline. No BMA approval is required for conversion of export proceeds, and settlement balances may be held indefinitely in corporate treasury accounts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Treasury Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for UK/EU EMIs used as supplementary payment corridors; Low for Bermuda-licensed fintech EMIs in the pure fiat space. Bermuda's Digital Asset Business Act 2018 does not license fiat-only electronic money institutions; a full banking licence under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999 is required to hold customer funds domestically. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise or Revolut generally do not support Bermuda-registered corporate entities with BMD/USD local account details. Such EMIs may be used only for cross-currency disbursement optimization, while the primary settlement rail for Steam and PlayStation payouts must remain a fully regulated Bermudian or US clearing bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda banks generally require a physical or video KYC interview for at least one director and disclosure of all beneficial owners. Remote onboarding is permissible for low-risk exempted companies when the corporate structure is transparent and all documents are apostilled, notarized, and supported by bankers' references from the existing relationship bank. Due to the tax-exempt character of the entity, most banks insist on a live video call with an executive director and the ultimate beneficial owner before opening operational accounts; a purely documentary, no-interview opening is rarely granted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt entity without a clear economic substance narrative
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, register of directors, share register, CRS/FATCA self-certification, economic substance compliance summary, and a board-approved explanation of the digital publishing business purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex multi-tier group structure with nominee or trust vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate organisational chart, declaration of trust or nominee agreement, ultimate beneficial ownership register extract, source of wealth and source of funds statements, and professional references from legal counsel and the existing parent-company bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity digital storefront revenue from Steam and PlayStation without transparent settlement records
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valve and Sony Interactive Entertainment platform payout reports, distribution and licensing agreements, royalty schedules, monthly consolidated transaction statements, and a documented treasury matching policy for reconciling platform inflows against game publishing revenues.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual cross-border wire patterns, including dividend repatriation and intercompany funding through multiple jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolutions approving each payment, audited financial statements, signed intercompany agreements, tax residence certificates of the receiving entities, and complete SWIFT MT103 records demonstrating the corresponding purpose codes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections must be sent via USD SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank to the Bermuda company's segregated escrow account at a licensed commercial bank. The wire's remittance information field must specify 'Subscription for newly issued shares of a Bermuda Exempted Company' or 'Capital contribution under the Bermuda Companies Act 1981'. The receiving bank will require a certified board resolution approving the share issuance, an updated register of members, a signed source-of-funds declaration, and notarized KYC documentation for each director. For Steam and PlayStation store payouts, the platform operating entities (Valve Corporation / Sony Interactive Entertainment) route settlement funds via ACH, Fedwire, or SWIFT to the designated USD operating account. The company must pre-notify the bank of expected platform payouts and provide the platform payout confirmation letters to facilitate rapid clearing without undue AML delays.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury disbursements will primarily use SWIFT MT103 messages for royalty payments, software licences, intercompany settlements, contractor payments, and dividend repatriation. USD same-day clearing can be executed through CHIPS or Fedwire via the correspondent US bank network. For any physical merchandise procurement (console peripherals, hardware bundles, promotional goods), a commercial letter of credit governed by UCP600 may be issued through Butterfield's trade finance desk; however, pure digital Steam publishing does not require an LC. Dividends paid to the immediate parent company must be supported by board minutes, unaudited or audited management accounts, and a CRS/FATCA tax classification certificate; the receiving bank will apply standard withholding document review and record the payment under the correct SWIFT transaction purpose code.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla FX forwards (USD/GBP, USD/EUR, USD/CAD) under ISDA 2002
Cross-currency swaps for swapping USD settlement balances into GBP or EUR operating liquidity
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for hedging emerging-market currency exposures arising from localized digital storefronts
Plain-vanilla FX options (calls and puts) for managing contingent revenue conversion scenarios
Multi-currency nostro netting arrangements with the clearing bank

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return with annual government fee payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late fee BMD 100; 10% surcharge on unpaid annual fee; Gazette notice followed by administrative strike-off after approximately 12 months of default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership annual confirmation and UBO change return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Beneficial Ownership Act 2017)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation at anniversary; any ownership change filed within 15 days of completion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to BMD 5,000; imprisonment up to 2 years; regulatory notice and strike-off for persistent non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Economic Substance Unit, Registrar of Companies, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months of financial year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial penalty BMD 10,000; additional BMD 10,000 daily penalties for continuing default; possible information exchange notice and strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit unless the exempted company qualifies as 'small' and shareholders waive the audit: minimum two of (turnover ≤ BMD 3.4M, assets ≤ BMD 2.6M, staff ≤ 50); permit companies and listed companies always require an approved auditor
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS-compliant financial statements prepared in BMD/USD

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: CSP verifies UBO register at each anniversary; every share transfer triggers a fresh BO return to the Registrar within 15 days of the transfer; annual confirmation is embedded in the Annual Return

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Bermuda Exempted Company; separate 15% Bermuda corporate income tax only for a constituent entity of an MNE group with consolidated revenue above EUR 750 million (OECD Pillar Two implementation), not applicable to a typical PC/console indie publisher
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate 0% under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, which guarantees no income, profits, capital, dividend or appreciation tax until 31 March 2035. Annual government fee to the Bermuda Registrar is the only recurring national cost; no preferential deduction is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Annual Return of an Exempted Company under Companies Act 1981, filed electronically via the Bermuda Online System ('BOS') of the Registrar of Companies; no corporate income tax return is prescribed in Bermuda.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 31 May in each calendar year following the registration year; for newly incorporated entities, the return is due in the next calendar year and every year thereafter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company legal name, registration number, date of incorporation, current registered office in Bermuda and principal place of business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a Bermuda address; the principal business address may be outside Bermuda if the entity is non-resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B - Share capital and shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, classes of shares, number of shares held and residential status of each member.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempted companies may be 100% non-resident owned and have no minimum paid-up capital; disclose non-resident shareholders with full legal names and DMA/ID numbers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, nationality and dates of appointment of directors and company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; no Bermuda residency condition applies, but a Bermuda-resident registered agent is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Particulars of mortgages, charges and any registrable beneficial owners to support the Bermuda beneficial ownership register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Steam/PlayStation payout accounts and escrow agents are not charges unless they create security; list controllers if holding 25% or more of shares/voting rights.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Bermuda Annual Return by 31 May creates default under the Companies Act 1981; the Registrar may impose monetary default penalties, issue demand notices, and continue to strike the company off the register and dissolve it. Late filing also prevents issuance of a Certificate of Good Standing used for Steam/PlayStation banking and platform accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Annual Economic Substance Declaration ('ESD') under the Economic Substance (Substantial Economic Presence) Regulations 2018/2019, filed through the Bermuda ESR portal/BOS administered by the Bermuda Ministry of Finance.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months after the end of the entity's financial year (e.g., for a 31 December year end, by 30 June following that financial year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A - Entity identification and relevant activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company number, financial year end, selected relevant activity (including 'Intellectual Property Business' where Steam/PlayStation publishing income derives from video game IP).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned company must still declare if it earns gross income from software publishing/royalties; failing to declare a relevant activity is a separate offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of CIGA performed in Bermuda: strategic direction, risk management, contract negotiation, licence acceptance, IP development decisions and treasury management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not describe activities performed by UK employees or Steam/Valve/PlayStation as Bermuda CIGA; the CIGA must actually be performed in Bermuda or the declaration is false.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees in Bermuda, physical premises address, and annual operating expenditure incurred in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an IP business, personnel and premises must be physically present in Bermuda; remote UK contractors do not count. An annual expenditure of zero or nominal amounts is a red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D - Income and tax status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from the relevant activity and whether the entity is tax resident elsewhere or claims another territory's tax residence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If UK central management and control exists, declare UK tax residence or risk penalties for both UK and Bermuda filings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESD attracts a civil penalty of up to BMD 10,000; failure to comply with a compliance notice attracts a penalty of up to BMD 50,000 and, for continuing failure, a daily penalty of up to BMD 10,000. The Ministry may also issue an information notice leading to an exchange of information with the UK, which frequently results in HMRC enquiry or CFC charge.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Bermuda levies no withholding tax on dividends paid by an Exempted Company to any shareholder, including a UK parent, and no Bermuda income or dividend tax applies to the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in Bermuda. Bermuda has no comprehensive Double Taxation Agreement and does not issue a Tax Residency Certificate for treaty relief because it imposes no corporate income tax. For a dividend path to the UK, no treaty form is filed; the UK recipient must apply UK dividend exemption or assess CFC under TIOPA 2010 Part 9A. Where a UK-source payment chain is involved, ordinary TRC protocols apply between the source state and UK, not Bermuda.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Bermuda statutory rate: 0% on royalties and 0% on interest paid by a Bermuda Exempted Company. If the counterparty or payer is UK-resident, UK withholding tax of 20% can arise on payments for copyright/periodical royalties for use of game IP (subject to treaty relief or UK source de minimis); UK-qualified loan interest paid to overseas lenders may likewise be subject to 20% UK withholding unless an exemption applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Bermuda statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold exists in BMD because Bermuda has no income tax base. Documentation obligations arise indirectly: (i) Bermuda ESR needs an internal cost and substance file; (ii) if the UK parent or HMRC asserts control/CFC, contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation is required under TIOPA 2010 Part 4 (OECD-aligned), including a Local/Master File when the UK group is in scope; and (iii) a qualified OECD Pillar Two domestic top-up regime may require minute-level computation in BMD.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Bermuda ESR apply fully to this Exempted Company. A PC/console game publisher earning Steam/PlayStation proceeds through software licences is regarded as carrying on an Intellectual Property Business (or, if the entity purchases and resells games as principal, a distribution/holding business) and must satisfy core income-generating activities, adequate staff, premises and expenditure in Bermuda. Failure creates a rebuttable presumption of a shell company and enables exchange of information with UK authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Violation / Shell Company Classification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing an Economic Substance Declaration as 'no relevant activity' while the entity earns active software publishing income; conducting all IP, contract and publishing decisions in the UK with no office or staff in Bermuda; claiming a Bermuda IP company status with only a mailbox and unlicensed directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda Economic Substance Regulations 2019 impose a financial penalty up to BMD 10,000 for failure to file the ESD, rising to BMD 50,000 plus BMD 10,000 per day for continued non-compliance after a notice. The Tax Commissioner may apply to strike the company off and can mandate information exchange to the UK, exposing the UK parent to CFC/DPT assessments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly make a false ESD are subject to criminal sanctions including fines and imprisonment, travel bans, disqualification as a Bermuda director and civil contribution to the company's penalty. In liquidation, UK directors who approved the sham structure may face misfeasance proceedings.
